changes: This update carries several important improvements:

Improved the OmniVoice batch generation feature to be significantly more accurate, especially with multiple short input lines (e.g. lines containing only one word). This used to cause poor separation of the individual words after generation, and often times would require to regenerate some of them due to poor results, but not anymore.

Fixed a couple of bugs which were affecting the Whisper-Trim feature's accuracy. It will now trim audio artifacts from the start/end of the generated TTS lines with a much higher rate of success, without affecting the actual words belonging to the line.

When creating a mod archive, you can now select which plugins you want to include in it, and which you prefer to keep out. Useful when some plugins are fully voiced, while others are still a work in progress.

When importing dialogue text from plugins which contain localizations via `.strings` files (mostly applies to the vanilla `.esm` plugins), you can now select which language you want to extract (from the ones available) instead of it always defaulting to English.
Additionally added an option in the app's Settings/General section to set the preferred language for extracting dialogue text from plugins when applicable.

Corrected a bug in the way `.7z` archives were created which could affect NexusMods' ability to show the file content preview for the archive (this was purely cosmetic and did not affect the created files' functionality).
Updated the help documentation to explain the new language selection options for extracting dialogue text from localized plugins.
Fixed an issue with the new OmniVoice automated installer, where it would report the installation as successful even if there was actually a problem
Added more detailed error descriptions if a problem occurred during the OmniVoice auto-installer, so it's easier to diagnose

The auto-installer now creates the folders `models\omnivoice\` under the `OmniVoice` root installation folder, which can be used for people who need to manually copy the TTS model weights files there when they cannot download them from the usual online sources, plus added `readme.txt` inside that folder path which explains it in detail
Enhanced the app installer to now use the more modern Windows folder lookup dialogue rather than the old legacy one
Hotfix: Resolved a bug with the new automated OmniVoice installer which wasn't properly installing `uv` when no system `uv` was available

Added explicit messages to the voices selection menu for OmniVoice describing the exact issue when voices weren't available (e.g. server is down, no voices were added etc.), instead of just presenting an empty list that was not selectable

Fixed a minor bug in the app's dialogue extraction mechanism which was missing a very small amount of lines, preventing them from being extracted (e.g. `DLC1SurgeryRumorTopic` with FormID `0000701C`, which the game engine dynamically changes to a real line saying "Heard any rumors lately?", was previously being dropped as an invalid line)
It's recommended to re-extract all your dialogues to catch some of these elusive lines (adds ~17 lines from Skyrim+DLCs, and possibly other mods)
Added OmniVoice's setup files to now be bundled with the app (no longer needing to pull them from GitHub)
Added an automated installer for OmniVoice under Settings/OmniVoice TTS which installs it from start to finish (no manual terminal commands required, no need to preinstall Git or uv anymore)
Users who prefer to install OmniVoice manually, or point the app to a preexisting installation, can still do so

Added automatic mirrors selection for sourcing the files required for the OmniVoice or Whisper Trim installations, allowing users from countries like China, which has limited access to the official sources (huggingface.co / pypi.org) to complete the installations successfully
Hotfix: Resolved a bug which would make the app silently crash and unable to save its settings when using a locale translation file (e.g. "zh_CN.json")
Everyone using the app in English were not affected by this bug
Additionally, slimmed down the installer size by cleaning up old files which were inadvertently being shipped with the app (it's now smaller by about ~1.9MB)
Added Simplified Chinese translation to the app installer
The installer will now prompt for language selection at startup
If the user selects Chinese, then that selection will carry over to the app language itself as well
Implemented a locale framework which allows for creating translations to other languages for the app's interface
Added two new options under `Settings\General`: App language selection, and an "Open translations folder" button
Added a Simplified Chinese app language option, covering most of the app's elements (credit to user "zhuabaobao123" for their translation efforts)
Added a `README.md` under the `assets\translations` folder with instructions on how to create new translations (pressing the "Open translations folder" button opens it directly)
No changes to app's functionality itself other than the above
Further optimized OmniVoice's VRAM usage
The app will now automatically choose whether to run its ASR (whisper) model on either GPU or CPU, depending on the user's VRAM availability (it only needs to run once on server startup)
The ASR model will now ALWAYS get unloaded from memory after it finishes its ONE TIME run on server startup, so that all available VRAM can be dedicated to running the TTS model
This is not to be confused with the app's own "Whisper Trim" model - OmniVoice runs its own internal ASR whisper model for transcribing the cloned voices' audio samples
Added a new setting associated with the above changes called "Whisper Device" (under Settings/OmniVoice), which defaults to "auto", but can also be explicitly set to always use CPU or GPU
Updated the in-app help documentation about the new "Whisper Device" setting

Same as before, once all cloned voices are transcribed, their transcriptions are now saved permanently, and the ASR model won't run on startup at all UNLESS there's voices with samples over 20 seconds, which will force it to run on startup every time

Improved the OmniVoice batch generation feature's error handling so that it now keeps lines that generated correctly and only discards and regenerates ones that didn't (instead of discarding and redoing the entire batch)
Reduced OmniVoice's VRAM usage by around ~1.8GB by no longer keeping its speech recognition model loaded on the GPU (it's only needed to transcribe a cloned voice's sample audio once on startup)

It now gets loaded into the system RAM and uses the CPU instead, which is a bit slower and adds a few seconds to the server's initial startup time, but at the benefit of using less VRAM for the duration of the entire session (which is a huge deal for users who have only 8GB of VRAM to start with)

Cloned voice audio samples now have their transcribed text saved with the voice, instead of being re-transcribed every time the server starts, preventing the need for loading the speech recognition model at startup altogether (existing voices are processed automatically on the next start)

Cloned voices with sample audio longer than 20 seconds are the exception and still get re-transcribed on each server start (keeping samples under 20 seconds avoids this). This is due to how OmniVoice works and cannot be helped
Improved error handling of failed Whisper model downloads which now show the actual error and save the full details to the Output Log, instead of a generic 'download failed' message
Hotfix: resolved an issue which was introduced in the previous app version (1.5.6) breaking TTS generation when using ElevenLabs.io (OmniVoice was not affected)
It's recommended to get this upgrade ASAP if you're using ElevenLabs.io

Significantly increased the accuracy of whisper trim so it more accurately recognizes the true boundaries of each word, and will no longer accidentally cut off part of a word belonging to the dialogue
Fixed an issue causing the TTS generation to get stuck for some users when using the batch generation feature for OmniVoice

Improved the accuracy of batch generation, and added a self correcting mechanism to automatically regenerate lines individually if they were part of a batch attempt that had mangled TTS speech (can rarely happen on some problematic lines)
Improved the accuracy of the Cutoff Guard feature to reduce the instances of it accidentally leaving in the throwaway word, which would sometimes happen
Fixed the search function's performance issues. It's now responsive again, and will not freeze the app while searching on sessions which have a large number of lines
Additional under the hood improvements and minor bug fixes

Improved duplicate-line detection so it now catches duplicates across all mods and combines them into one line (rather than just combining duplicate lines from the same mod). This simplifies the creation process, and saves on TTS generation time
Fixed a multi-second freeze that happened every time you edited a line or variation
Fixed the list scrolling back to the top when adding or removing variations
Added a "Show Errors" option to the Filter Results dropdown to quickly find lines with errors
Fixed UI glitch where the TTS API status widget was constantly resizing during certain batch operations (e.g. FUZ packing)
Set the new OmniVoice batch generation feature to skip over lines with custom TTS when creating the batch payload, then returning and re-generating them individually right after
Implemented a new feature ("Batch Generation") which **significantly** increases OmniVoice TTS generation speed by around x5-10!
You can find it under the "Phase 1" card custom TTS settings (it's off by default)
Added the ability to configure and create a FOMOD installer when creating the final mod archive (with full compatibility for BSA archiving as well)
Added an additional 500 and 1000 options to the "Items per page" dropdown menu, allowing you to see more lines per page, and also made the choice persistent between app sessions
Added the ability to interrupt a batch playback process by clicking the individual playback button next to a specific line

Fixed an issue where a batch LIP generation job would sometimes error out due to file lock conflicts when using multiple CPU cores for faster parallel generation (the more CPU cores used the more likely this could have happened)
Fixed a bug where adding variations to a line that's inside a group made the variations not appear
Added an ETA countdown timer for when generating batch TTS audio
Added batch controls to Play, Trim, Regen multiple selected lines in the table
Introducing dialogue templates: allow you to create reusable templates from various dialogue sources which are saved inside the app, reducing the dependence on external dialogue sources
Ability to Export/Import dialogue templates, sharing them with others (including custom edits, TTS settings etc.)

Added a dialogue search wizard: allows you to simply select a folder, and it will automatically find all .esp/.esm plugins containing dialogue lines, allowing you to import some or all of them at once
Ability to easily create a template from any existing session
Improved the app's ability to work with hundreds of plugins inside a single session
Added a second warning confirmation before removing a dialogue source which already has TTS generated for it
Various UI changes and improvements
Various under the hood improvements and bug fixes

Fixed parallel CPU execution for LIP/FUZ generation: the app will now correctly use all the CPU cores set under the settings/general section when generating LIP/FUZ files, significantly increasing generation speed.

Fixed a session data corruption bug which would result in project data loss if the app was closed unexpectedly mid operation. This is an important "under the hood" update and it's recommended to get it as soon as possible.
Moved the "Custom TTS Settings" option to the "Phase 1: TTS Gen" card
Added an optional "Cutoff Guard" feature to mitigate an issue with OmniVoice sometimes cutting off part of the last word in the generated audio (utilizing Faster-Whisper)
Added the ability to create custom Groups for voice lines and implemented a tabbed layout for them when present (any batch actions are now scoped per the active group)
Added a right-click context menu for easy management of groups and other batch actions (works for both single and multi-line selections)

Fixed a bug where applying custom TTS settings for a hard replaced line would incorrectly change its color to teal (which indicates user custom line edits). Instead it correctly keeps its green color, indicating a hard replaced line
Fixed a bug where a Trim on a single line would also automatically apply to other lines if they were previously manually regenerated.
Standardized support for both TTS and Lip-Sync generation for the following non-English languages: Japanese, Korean, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Chinese, and Russian.
Added lip-sync generation support for Chinese and Japanese
If you have Whisper Trim already setup, you will need to re-install it after this update
Added support for non-English languages (including Chinese, Japanese etc.)
Added trim ability using faster-whisper (AI based)
Improved ElevenLabs integration
Improved UI icons across the app
Improved the table structure and design
Various bug fixes
Fixed a bug that prevented OmniVoice server from starting for the first time
Added timeout, retry, and recovery logic to prevent a batch TTS generation process from getting stuck if the server did not return an output for a particular line
Improved installer workflow when updating from an existing version
Fixed the app title bar displaying incorrect app version
Updated the installer to detect an existing setup and update it in-place whilst preserving existing settings/sessions
Added an in-app "Check for Updates" feature that notifies you of new versions on Nexus with a changelog and one-click download link.
Fixed TTS lines occasionally getting permanently stuck at "processing" after an error.
Fixed Regen sometimes queuing a line without ever processing it during an active batch run.
Fixed an issue with parsing restricted ElevenLabs API keys which previously resulted in a generic error
Added the ability to import dialogue lines directly from .esm/.esp plugin files, retiring the need for using SSEEdit (still supported as a legacy option)
Initial changelog-tracked release.
